app_locationNeeded: Allow location access to find the nearest open vet, or type an address.
app_noCoverage: Snuffel covers Europe. We have no data for this location.
app_offline: You're offline. Showing places saved on this phone.
app_noSaved: Places you save appear here, and they also work without internet.
app_noDogs: Add your dog to get care reminders and advice that fits your dog.
app_invalidDate: Use the format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2021-04-30.
app_notifDenied: Notifications are off for Snuffel. Turn them on in your phone's settings to get reminders.
app_offlineAreaText: Places within 15 km of your home are kept on this phone, so Snuffel also works without signal.
app_setHomeHere: Use my current location as home
app_privacyText: Snuffel has no accounts and no tracking. Your dogs, their health files, reminders, saved places and chats stay on this phone (and in your phone's own backup). Your location is only used to search and is not stored. Questions to the AI assistant, with a short summary of the dog's file if you allow it, are sent to Azure OpenAI in the EU and are not used for training. Spoken questions are turned into text by your phone's own speech recognition (Apple or Google); Snuffel never receives audio.
app_aboutText: Snuffel helps you find independent vets, groomers, shops, trainers, dog hotels and play areas across Europe, and shows which places belong to large chains.
app_errLoad: Couldn't load places. Check your connection and try again.
app_voiceUnavailable: Speech recognition isn't available on this phone right now.
app_voiceDenied: Allow the microphone and speech recognition to ask by voice.
app_dogFileIntro: Vet visits, diagnoses, medication, allergies, weight and behaviour in one place. Everything stays on this phone.
app_shareWithAi: Use this file for AI advice
app_shareWithAiText: A short summary (allergies, medication, recent events) goes along with your questions, so the assistant can take earlier cases into account.
app_exportPasswordHint: Optional: protect the file with a password. Without it nobody can open the file, you neither.
app_importPassword: This file is protected. Enter the password.
app_importFailed: This file could not be read. Choose a Snuffel export (.json).
app_ob_welcomeText: Everything for your dog nearby, with independent vets and businesses first.
app_ob_f1: Find independent vets, groomers, dog trainers and dog walking areas
app_ob_f2: Emergency: a vet that's open now, in one tap
app_ob_f3: AI help with health and behaviour questions, also by voice
app_ob_f4: A health file and reminders for your dog, only on your phone
app_ob_areaText: Snuffel keeps the places around your home on your phone, so you can find them without signal too. Your location never leaves your phone.
app_ob_postcode: Or type your postcode or town
app_ob_areaDone: {n} places in your area are now on your phone.
app_ob_dogText: With a profile, AI help takes age, breed and weight into account. Everything stays on your phone.
app_ob_vetText: Choose your own vet. In Emergency it then appears at the top, with a call button.
app_ob_vetNone: No vets found in your area. You can do this later: open a vet and tap ⭐ My vet.
app_ob_vetNeedsArea: Set your area first to see the vets near you here.
app_ob_doneText: Set reminders for vaccinations and deworming on your dog's page. You can replay this tour in Settings.
app_ob_aiText: Not sure about health or behaviour? Type or say your question. You're chatting with an AI assistant: not a vet, but a quick first assessment. If it's urgent, AI help points you the way right away.
app_aiStarter1: My dog has been eating less since yesterday. Should I worry?
app_aiStarter2: How can I help my dog with fear of fireworks?
app_aiStarter3: My dog ate something he shouldn't have. What now?
app_aiStarter4: How do I house-train my puppy?
app_aiStarter5: My dog pulls on the lead. What can I do?
app_aiStarter6: How often should I deworm my dog?

app_aiEmergencyLine: Is it really going wrong right now?
app_aiAddDog: Add your dog for advice that fits
app_newChatConfirm: Delete this conversation? This can't be undone.
